title: I let Opus 5 make a game until I couldn’t stop playing it
author: toastyandre
selftext:
I started using Opus 5 until I ended up with a game I genuinely couldn’t stop playing after just one day.

If you want to try it out the demo,

Link: [https://sasbyxan.itch.io/farm-factory-demo](https://sasbyxan.itch.io/farm-factory-demo)

  
AI disclamer:

Art, Code, Sound is made by AI.

comments.author: MrET97
comments.body: Pretty fun! Let players skip the start though, many won't be patient enough to watch the AI cutscenes.

replies.author: toastyandre
replies.body: You're right, I missed that! I'll add a skip option.

replies.author: Easy-Coconut-33
replies.body: I agree, there should be a skip button for that. OP should release it on app store and play store.

replies.author: toastyandre
replies.body: d.o.n.e! :) skip and faster cutscene now!

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/b9q2ehus8qrh1.png?width=2354&format=png&auto=webp&s=bcbce66480687cb158ba8db52d332aa7f73041c1

sorry to be harsh, but from the beginning of the game you have this transparent menu that has two menus clashing. you should really fix this. It looks bad to have menus like this. I mean this is the first thing players see and it's already busted. I understand glitches and bugs but this is the very first interaction in the entire game, you need to make this menu not transparent so it can fully draw on top of the main menu and be readable

replies.author: toastyandre
replies.body:
This is weird, as I haven’t encountered this issue myself. Have you tried refreshing the page or going fullscreen? That might fix it, but I’ll of course look into it as well.

https://preview.redd.it/31j7wszg9qrh1.png?width=1277&format=png&auto=webp&s=1b9681e7cbb2ab1d519dde3a94ac11b550b4e0bd

comments.author: toastyandre
comments.body: Btw, thanks a lot for all the feedback! And yes, I’ll definitely make sure the intro can be skipped.
